# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta2

Fixes the multi-folder workspace so every folder gets its own live Pi agent and shows its real sessions.

## Multi-folder fixes

- Focusing a folder now spawns its Pi runtime when none is live, instead of parking the folder on a permanent "Runtime unavailable" preview. Clicking any folder gives you a usable agent; live folders still re-focus instantly without recreation.
- Keeps every other folder running while you switch focus. Background folders are not destroyed when you open or prompt another folder.
- Background folder session previews now always read from disk, so a folder with saved sessions no longer reads as "No sessions yet" while its runtime is settled in the background.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
